responsibility: Implements the root support library's cross-platform file object used by the D front end for direct file I/O. `File` owns a filename wrapper plus an optional in-memory buffer, provides read/write/remove operations for POSIX and Windows, and appends sentinel bytes after reads so scanner-style consumers can safely walk the loaded source text.
same_name_distinction: Implements File’s platform-specific read, write, remove, destructor, and filename-backed construction behavior, including sentinel bytes after reads; unlike file.h, it supplies the operating-system I/O code behind the File abstraction.
